thread:
Sara M.: quick check — doing a final pass on the three landing pages (Hosted / Dedicated / Private). want to validate routing for webinar signups + benchmark copy. can we sync quick?
Tom G.: yup — got a 10m window. main asks?
Sara M.: 1) hero lines that clearly separate value prop for each mode 2) lead routing from webinar vs trial downloads 3) benchmark blurb placement (above or below pricing)
Li C.: for routing — recommend: webinar -> sales-seq A (enterprise-focused), trial download -> automated nurture (PLG). keeps SDR touch where it matters.
Emma P.: agree. for hero: Hosted = "Fastest path to production". Dedicated = "Committed capacity, predictable latency". Private = "VPC & on-prem for regulated workloads". short, benefit-first.
Jon D.: those sound fine, but tone needs to be more developer-first. maybe add a lead-in: "Engineered for production inference" before the mode-specific bit?
Sara M.: good call. proposed hosted hero: "Engineered for production inference — Hosted API for fastest time-to-value."
Tom G.: can we A/B test short vs long hero? e.g., variant A = single line; variant B = 2-line with 2nd line clarifying cost/latency tradeoff.
Emma P.: yes. we'll wire up experiment flags in the page metadata. can we also test moving the benchmark snippet into the hero subline for Hosted?
Li C.: cautious about putting benchmarks in hero — compliance/legal sometimes flags numbers. better to put a single benchmark claim + CTA to full benchmark page.
Sara M.: ok: short claim + link. Example: "<1s median token latency on small configs — see benchmark details."
Jon D.: routing snippet for engineering: in the form submission handler, set utm_source, and map to segments: 
```
if (utm_source === 'webinar') route = 'enterprise-sdr';
else if (utm_source === 'trial') route = 'plg-nurture';
else route = 'inbound-marketing';
```
Tom G.: perfect. we'll add hidden field campaign=webinar-2026 for the webinar signups to ensure attribution.
Sara M.: what about Private page — needs audit & KMS callouts in hero or immediately below?
Emma P.: immediately below hero. short bullets: KMS/HSM, audit logs, air-gapped option. designers will handle microcopy.
Jon D.: also add an expand/collapse with "How deployment works" for technical readers. include a small diagram link.
Li C.: inbound routing for Dedicated trials: if customer selects "Enterprise" checkbox route to dedicated-sales; else regular plg. small form change.
Sara M.: action items: Emma update copy variants, Jon add tech-expand content and diagram link, Li update routing logic + create mapping doc, Tom set up experiment flags and hidden campaign field. I'll draft webinar follow-up email with routing notes.
Emma P.: assigning copy tasks now. will drop first pass in Figma by EOD. :calendar:
Tom G.: I'll roll flags into the A/B config and share dashboard metrics to watch (signup -> demo conversion).
deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: staging preview URL -> https://staging.redwood-inference.com/three-mode-landing?exp=heroAB (build #4821)
Sara M.: sweet. please post the staging link when it's live so ops can sanity check form submission mapping. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
